allowed_sources: conceptgate/ module names, function/class names, docstrings, explicit comments
tests and fixtures encoding expected behavior directly
commit messages copied verbatim with hash
disallowed_sources: general model knowledge about ontology/OWL/GUFO/software architecture
inference from file path or symbol name alone without a supporting text span

evidence_items.text:
essential_feature participates in the is-a DAG.
    structural_composition creates has-a composition edges (part-whole graph),
    returned separately in the composition field.
evidence_items.extraction_note: Live @mcp.tool docstring (this repo's currently-registered run_pipeline tool, re-confirmed 2026-07-27) states that structural_composition denotes a part-whole (has-a) relation. This establishes the general ontological meaning of the type, but does not by itself name any specific feature -- kept as corroborating context, not sole support.

evidence_items.text: 카페린의 손잡이는 카페린 몸체의 구성 부분이다
evidence_items.extraction_note: Pre-registered fixture evidence string for concept 카페린's feature 손잡이, frozen in a sibling experiment's design commit (experiments/2026-07-25_e2.3_global_invariant_generalization) before any trial of that experiment executed. States in plain prose that 손잡이 IS a constituent part (구성 부분) of 카페린's body -- a direct, instance-bound assertion of a part-whole relation for this specific feature, independent of any type label. Combined with ev9's general definition of what structural_composition means, this binds the abstract type definition to this specific feature.
